content_of_post_to_comment: Indeed, if any of these people actually believed what they were saying, they would immediately unplug all their servers. “This technology we control might destroy humanity, therefore we're gonna write a strongly worded essay but keep running the technology.” What?
comment: The tension may be less hypocrisy than a coordination problem: individuals can believe a risk is real while still seeing unilateral withdrawal as costly. The harder question is who gets to set the stopping rule.
